contradictions.a: 未聞道而求之不得不博故曰益
contradictions.b: 未聞道，故必廣學以求之，故曰損之又損。
contradictions.why: A identifies 'increasing' (益) with the pursuit of learning before knowing the Way; B identifies this same pursuit as 'decreasing' (損之又損).

contradictions.a: 已聞道而為之不得不無為而已故曰損
contradictions.b: 行道者，已聞道矣。既聞道，則無事乎無為，故曰損。
contradictions.why: A says one who knows the Way must practice 'non-action' (無為) and calls this 'decreasing' (損); B says one who knows the Way has no need for 'non-action' and calls this 'decreasing' (損).
